question_text:
A cylindrical specimen of steel having a diameter of 15.2 mm ( 0.60 in.) and length of 250 mm (10.0 in.) is deformed elastically in tension with a force of $48,900 \mathrm{~N}(11,000 \mathrm{lb})$. Using the data contained in  table 7.1 , determine the following:
(a) The amount by which this specimen will elongate in the direction of the applied stress.
(b) The change in diameter of the specimen.

Give the answer as a tuple (answer to (a), answer to (b)).

Reference:
"Table 7.1 Room-Temperature Elastic and Shear Moduli and Poisson's Ratio for Various Materials
\begin{tabular}{|l|l|l|l|l|l|}
\hline \multirow[b]{2}{*}{Material} & \multicolumn{2}{|c|}{Modulus of Elasticity} & \multicolumn{2}{|c|}{Shear Modulus} & \multirow[b]{2}{*}{Poisson's Ratio} \\
\hline & GPa & $10^6 \mathrm{psi}$ & GPa & $10^6 \mathrm{psi}$ & \\
\hline \multicolumn{6}{|c|}{Metal Alloys} \\
\hline Tungsten & 407 & 59 & 160 & 23.2 & 0.28 \\
\hline Steel & 207 & 30 & 83 & 12.0 & 0.30 \\
\hline Nickel & 207 & 30 & 76 & 11.0 & 0.31 \\
\hline Titanium & 107 & 15.5 & 45 & 6.5 & 0.34 \\
\hline Copper & 110 & 16 & 46 & 6.7 & 0.34 \\
\hline Brass & 97 & 14 & 37 & 5.4 & 0.34 \\

\hline Spinel ( $\mathrm{MgAl}_2 \mathrm{O}_4$ ) & 260 & 38 & - & - & - \\
\hline Magnesium oxide (MgO) & 225 & 33 & - & - & 0.18 \\
\hline Zirconia $\left(\mathrm{ZrO}_2\right)^a$ & 205 & 30 & - & - & 0.31 \\
\hline Mullite ( $3 \mathrm{Al}_2 \mathrm{O}_3-2 \mathrm{SiO}_2$ ) & 145 & 21 & - & - & 0.24 \\
\hline Glass-ceramic (Pyroceram) & 120 & 17 & - & - & 0.25 \\
\hline Fused silica ( $\mathrm{SiO}_2$ ) & 73 & 11 & - & - & 0.17 \\

\hline \multicolumn{6}{|c|}{Polymers ${ }^{\text {b }}$} \\

response:
## Solution

**Given data:**
- Diameter $d_0 = 15.2$ mm, length $l_0 = 250$ mm, force $F = 48{,}900$ N
- From Table 7.1 (Steel): $E = 207$ GPa, $\nu = 0.30$

**Stress and strain:**

$$A = \pi\left(\frac{d_0}{2}\right)^2 = \pi(7.6\times10^{-3})^2 = 1.815\times10^{-4}\,\text{m}^2$$

$$\sigma = \frac{F}{A} = \frac{48900}{1.815\times10^{-4}} \approx 2.694\times10^{8}\,\text{Pa}$$

$$\epsilon = \frac{\sigma}{E} = \frac{2.694\times10^{8}}{207\times10^{9}} \approx 1.301\times10^{-3}$$

**(a) Elongation:**

$$\Delta l = \epsilon \cdot l_0 = (1.301\times10^{-3})(250) \approx 0.3255\,\text{mm}$$

**(b) Change in diameter** (lateral strain $= -\nu\epsilon$):

$$\Delta d = -\nu\,\epsilon\,d_0 = -(0.30)(1.301\times10^{-3})(15.2) \approx -0.00594\,\text{mm}$$

$$\boxed{(0.3255,\,-0.00594)}$$
